title: Alphabetized Spawn Eggs
description: Reverts the "Thematic" Spawn Egg Sorting introduced in 1.21.11 back to the Alphabetized Sorting in 1.21.10 and Earlier.
body: Reverts the "Thematic" Spawn Egg Sorting introduced in 1.21.11 back to the Alphabetized Sorting in 1.21.10 and Earlier. The opinions on the "Thematic" Spawn Egg Sorting is Very Mixed while the Alphabetized Eggs are universally liked.
